title: Walsh average of a field pairing generator
statement: Let $\ell\neq 0$, let $\mathbb F$ be the degree-$\ell$ extension field of $\mathbb F_2$, let $\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^d$, and let $a_1,\ldots,a_d\in\mathbb F$. Choose $s$ uniformly from $\mathbb F$ and form the sign vector whose $i$th coordinate is $(-1)^{\operatorname{Tr}_{\mathbb F/\mathbb F_2}(a_i s)}$. The average of its Walsh character indexed by $\gamma$ is $1$ if $\sum_{i=1}^d\gamma_i a_i=0$ in $\mathbb F$, and $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ maps the $d$ indices into the degree-$\ell$ extension field
